name: Opensource UI
summary: Free MIT-licensed React and Next.js library of 207+ copy-paste components, from forms and widgets to Apple device mockups.
description: A free React and Next.js UI library of copy-paste components, each with a live preview and copy-ready TypeScript source built on Tailwind CSS v4. 207 components are organized across 30 categories — buttons, inputs, tables, calendars, toasts, clocks, widgets — alongside Apple-style device mockups (iPhone, MacBook, iPad, Apple Watch, iPod, browser). MIT licensed for personal and commercial use, no npm package and no vendor lock-in.
